services.name: All Charters
services.desc: One of the most popular bottom fish species to target in the Puget Sound is lingcod. Contrary to its name, the lingcod is actually not a cod; these eel shaped fish are part of the greenling family of fish species. The meat of a lingcod is white and flaky much like a cod, halibut, or any of your traditional white meat fish seen around the West coast, but lingcod generally proves to be superior table fare with its moist texture. This moist, flaky lingcod meat doesn’t dry out as easily as a halibut or cod meat, which makes it an even more desirable fish. With the table fare of a lingcod being nothing short of delicious, it is no surprise why fellow fishermen look for a chance at reeling in one

blurb: Cut Plug Charters offers guided salmon fishing trips in Seattle's Puget Sound 11 months a year, excluding May. They provide private and shared charters with opportunities to catch multiple salmon species using active fishing techniques like mooching, vertical jigging, and trolling. Trips run mornings and afternoons with groups up to 6 per boat, and larger groups accommodated on multiple boats.
